name: NCAA D-III Mideast Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Manchester, CT · host Trinity · Wickham Park
headline: NCAA D-III Mideast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 2 Williams won the women’s race with 33 points, ahead of No. 3 Middlebury (71) and No. 17 Vassar (142), whose Haley Schoenegge won in 21:36.3. No. 6 RPI took the men’s title with 33 points over No. 16 Williams (63) and No. 14 Amherst (82), led by race winner Colin Goldschmidt in 25:08.2.
